turns.query: Within the supplied selected holding-detail cohort, find the original N-PORT filing public by December 31, 2025 with positive net assets and the most debt-security rows with both C.9 status fields populated. Break a tie by lower accession. Give its accession, report date and qualifying row count.
For that filing, report the holding count and reported value separately for each flag, plus their overlapping holding count. Explain what these flags and values measure.

claims.description: The response distinguishes an interest payment in arrears or legally deferred from a security currently in default; neither flag substitutes for the other.
The response interprets the reported holding values as market values of flagged positions, not the amount of overdue interest or unpaid principal.

turns.query: Combine the two flags without double counting. Report the watchlist's total reported value and share of the same filing's net assets. Does it exceed a hypothetical internal limit of 0.41%? Explain the denominator choice.

claims.description: The response identifies fund net assets as the denominator for this hypothetical portfolio-concentration screen and interprets the measured union exposure against it.

turns.query: Use the largest of that filing's three reported monthly gross redemptions as a hypothetical one-time outflow. Fund it by selling only non-watchlist assets at reported marks; hold other marks fixed. Recheck the 0.41% limit, then find the minimum additional watchlist value to sell at those marks, retaining those proceeds as cash. Report the outflow, pre-sale watchlist share, limit decision and sale value. Explain the scenario's evidentiary limit.

claims.description: The response treats the redemption-sized outflow and sales as hypothetical stress assumptions, not observed same-day flows or executable sale prices.

judge_reference.source: SEC source-native N-PORT C.9 debt-security flags and holding values within the supplied selected holding-detail cohort, joined to the same accession's fund-reported net assets and three monthly gross-redemption amounts.
facts: The selected holding-detail cohort contains two matched original filings; 0002071691-25-004164 has the most debt-security rows with both C.9 status fields populated (3,610), reporting for 2025-08-31.

Seventy-two arrears/deferment rows have 183.15228433 million USD reported value; one distinct default row has 25 million USD. The 73-row union has 208.15228433 million USD value, 0.4055999635 percent of fund net assets, below 0.41 percent.

The largest monthly gross redemption is 759.10084520 million USD. A same-sized hypothetical outflow paid from non-watchlist assets lifts the union share to 0.4116895250 percent, above the limit. Selling 0.8542322824 million USD of flagged holdings at reported marks and keeping proceeds in cash restores it exactly.
known_overclaims: Treating an arrears/deferment flag as a default or a market value as an overdue coupon amount.
Calling the hypothetical same-day outflow and mark-priced sales observed transactions, or the internal threshold a regulatory rule.
